lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 12 distinct vertical white lines identified; spacing is wider and uniform in the mid-torso region and becomes progressively narrower toward the posterior flank.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Line segments 10, 11, and 12 at the posterior region exhibit fragmentation and terminate before reaching the lower ventral line of the torso.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of approximately 8 high-contrast white spots is visible on the posterior haunch and upper hind limb region.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Three distinct spots align horizontally across the mid-section of the thigh, forming a semi-connected geometric line.

other_distinctive_markers: Visible white chevron patch on the bridge of the muzzle and prominent white transverse bands on the lower limbs above the hooves.
